text: 该修订草案共六章100条，较现行税收征管法新增13条、删除7条、修改75条，章节设置保持现行税收征管法基本架构。本次修订聚焦贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，充分适应新经济、新业态发展需要，更好落实税收法定原则，对接个人所得税等新税制改革，巩固和拓展税收征管改革成果，既突出保障国家税收安全，又注重维护法治公平经济税收秩序，并将纳税人合法权益保护贯穿制度设计全链条，进一步为广大经营主体特别是合规经营纳税人营造公平、透明、可预期的发展环境。
text_en: The draft amendment has six chapters and 100 articles. Compared with the current Tax Collection and Administration Law, it adds 13 articles, deletes 7 articles and modifies 75 articles, while maintaining the basic chapter structure of the current Tax Collection and Administration Law. This amendment focuses on implementing the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, fully adapting to the development needs of the new economy and new business forms, better implementing the principle of statutory taxation, aligning with new tax system reforms such as individual income tax, and consolidating and expanding the achievements of tax collection and administration reform. It both highlights safeguarding national tax security and emphasizes maintaining a law-based, fair economic and tax order, and runs the protection of taxpayers' lawful rights and interests through the entire chain of institutional design, further creating a fair, transparent and predictable development environment for the broad market entities, especially law-abiding taxpayers.
